name: site-power-loss
purpose: Cut power to the whole dc1 site at once: both cores, both distribution switches, the firewall and both hosts. dc2 must keep forwarding inside its site, and the dc2 firewall must take over the VRRP address. After power returns, dc1 must boot, rejoin the DCI and take the VRRP address back.
reasons: After the steps, dc1-to-dc2-over-dci: 10 pings lost in total at one ping every 100 ms, longest measured stop at least 0.309572 s, 0 duplicated.
After the steps, dc2-to-dc1-over-dci: 22 pings lost in total at one ping every 100 ms, longest measured stop at least 0.417909 s, 0 duplicated.
After the steps, dc1-traffic-to-vrrp: 6 pings lost in total at one ping every 100 ms, longest measured stop 0.101374 to 0.308247 s, 0 duplicated.
Step dc1 power restored is fail.
